attr.alt: Dr. William Sung, DMD of Grand Mission Dentistry

nodes.v: Dr. William Sung is highly regarded in the field of restorative and implant dentistry, known for his commitment to patient-centered care and meticulous attention to detail. With extensive training in advanced procedures, Dr. Sung has helped countless patients in Richmond, TX, restore their smiles with dental implants.

Trust in his expertise to guide your dental care journey with precision and compassion. You can also schedule virtual consultations with Dr. Sung. The practice speaks English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Korean and Arabic.
Book a consultation with Dr. Sung

“This is an amazing dentist and their hospitality is outstanding. They are also financially understanding. The dental assistant Rida made the experience exceptionally great. She is great at her job and so is everyone at this dentistry. The dentist is also very understanding, kind, and thorough concerning exams. I would highly recommend anyone to come here.”

“Amazing dentistry! The entire staff here is fantastic. Due to past experiences I used to be pretty anxious about going to the dentist until I started coming here. The hygienists are great and gentle! Always have enjoyable conversations during my appointments. Definitely recommend if you're looking for a new dentistry office!”
Actual Grand Mission Dentistry patients. Tap any case to see it full size.
Results vary from patient to patient. These are individual outcomes and depend on oral health, bone, lifestyle and the specifics of treatment. Yours will be discussed at your consultation.

/* CHAPTER 05 — THE SPECIALIST: case gallery drift + velocity-reactive
   service marquee. */
WZ.add(function (W) {
  /* Case gallery: the four cases rise on a slight diagonal, and each drifts
     against the scroll so the block never sits completely still. */
  gsap.from('#gallery .gallery__item', {
    opacity: 0,
    y: 40,
    duration: 0.9,
    stagger: 0.08,
    ease: 'power3.out',
    scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#gallery', start: 'top 86%' },
  });
  gsap.utils.toArray('#gallery img').forEach(function (img, i) {
    gsap.fromTo(
      img,
      { yPercent: -4 - i, scale: 1.1 },
      {
        yPercent: 4 + i,
        scale: 1.1,
        ease: 'none',
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#gallery', start: 'top bottom', end: 'bottom top', scrub: 0.7 },
      }
    );
  });

  /* Service marquee — speed and direction bend with how fast you scroll, so
     the page feels physically connected to the wheel. */
  var row = document.getElementById('svcTrack');
  if (!row) return;
  row.innerHTML += row.innerHTML; /* a seamless loop needs a duplicate */
  var half = row.scrollWidth / 2;
  var loop = gsap.to(row, {
    x: -half,
    duration: 30,
    ease: 'none',
    repeat: -1,
    modifiers: { x: function (x) { return (parseFloat(x) % half) + 'px'; } },
  });
  var vt = gsap.quickTo(loop, 'timeScale', { duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2' });
  ScrollTrigger.create({
    onUpdate: function (self) {
      var v = self.getVelocity() / 380;
      vt(gsap.utils.clamp(-7, 7, v === 0 ? 1 : v < 0 ? Math.min(-1, v) : Math.max(1, v)));
    },
  });
  ScrollTrigger.addEventListener('scrollEnd', function () { vt(1); });
});
</script>
